gloss.intro: The words developers (and the AI teams) use, in plain English.
gloss.switch.help: Dotted words get a plain explanation when thou hoverest over them.
gloss.backlog.text: Ideas and work not yet planned. Nothing there is worked upon until it moveth to To be done.
gloss.sprint.text: A short stretch of work (often a week or two) with an agreed set of cards to finish.
gloss.standup.text: A quick check-in: what each team member did, what they do next, and what hindereth them.
gloss.bug.text: Something that worketh not as it should.
gloss.test.text: Trying a finished piece of work to check it doth what was asked, ere thou accept it.
gloss.commit.text: A saved snapshot of the code, with a short note of what changed. Thou canst ever return to one.
gloss.push.text: Sending saved snapshots (commits) from this machine up to GitHub, that they be backed up and shared.
gloss.branch.text: A separate line of work in the code, so changes may be made without touching the main version.
gloss.merge.text: Joining a branch’s changes back into the main version.
gloss.repo.text: The project’s folder of code and its full history of commits, usually also kept on GitHub.
gloss.refactor.text: Tidying the code without changing what it doth: smaller files, clearer names, less repetition.
gloss.deploy.text: Putting a new version live, for example onto a server where folk use it.
gloss.kanban.text: A board with columns (To do, In progress, Done) where cards move left to right as work happeneth.
gloss.wip.text: Work in progress: the most cards a column should hold, that the team may finish things ere starting more.
gloss.pr.text: Asking that a branch’s changes be checked and merged into the main version.
gloss.hook.text: A small command that runneth by itself at a set moment, e.g. when an AI session starteth, so the team heareth thy comments.
gloss.token.text: The unit in which AI usage is counted: roughly a few letters of text read or written. Fewer tokens, more of thy plan left.
gloss.agent.text: An AI that worketh on its own upon a task: readeth the code, maketh changes, runneth checks, and reporteth back.

play.send: Send this code to {name}. They paste it in Add a friend. When they have added thee, read the 6 safety words to each other and tick They match: then the project is offered them.
play.checked: {name} is thy friend already: the project is offered them now.
play.unchecked: {name} is thy friend already, yet not checked. Check the safety words with them and tick They match: then the project is offered them.
play.err.name: Give thy friend a name
feat.help: Switch a feature on for one friend, a few, or all. Each friend receiveth but their own switches, sent o'er thy share links.
feat.label: What it is
fp.help: Upload or paste a portrait of this person, for thine eyes alone. They never receive it. Should they join with their own, thine still showeth here; Remove bringeth theirs back.
chgrole.label: Change roles
chgrole.help: Thou alone settest these. {name} keepeth the share role above; a Project manager may raise changes and see their approvals.
sc.title: Keyboard shortcuts
sc.move: Next or previous card in the list
sc.help: Small nudges at the page's foot, ne'er a pop-up o'er thy work. They stay silent during a break, focus or the night. Kept in this browser.
sc.note: Shortcuts serve not whilst thou typest in a box.
bin.title: 🗑 Assistant's bin
bin.intro: Messages the firewall kept from the inbox and the cards. Naught is lost: let one through and it is posted as 'twas meant.
bin.link.title: See what the firewall kept away
bin.empty: The bin is empty. The firewall hath caught naught.
bin.why.duplicate: Why: the same message once more
srv.retro.title: 🔁 Retro: {short}
srv.retro.ask: Add this to WAYS-OF-WORKING under "{section}"? Go?
srv.retro.addedEnd: There is no section "{wanted}", so this went at the end of WAYS-OF-WORKING under "{section}": {line}
srv.retro.declined: Not yet: naught changed in WAYS-OF-WORKING. Card closed.
dod.intro: Two short lists the company readeth: Ready ere a card moveth to doing, Done ere it is handed thee to test. One item per line; empty returneth to the default.
chgwin.intro: When changes may go live. One window per line, like "tue 20:00-22:00 Release" (day mon..sun or all). Empty meaneth any hour. A change card may not move to Done outside a window; emergency changes from an incident may.
today.pick.intro: Tick the projects thou wouldst work on today. The rest do rest, and are hid until thou tap Show all.
lead.todayPick.help: The first time thou openest the board each day, a small dialog asketh which projects thou workest on today. The others rest, hid until thou tap Show all.
approvals.note.ph: A short note for {name}: why not?
approvals.note.need: Write a short note first: thy friend shall see it.
approvals.setting: Approvals: cards a friend raiseth await my OK
approvals.setting.hint: With this on, a friend's card sitteth in the Approvals tab of the inbox. No company taketh it up till thou approve.
featreq.intro: Tell {name} what thou wouldst have. It ever awaiteth {name}'s OK ere it becometh a card.
featreq.need: Give it a title and say what thou wouldst have.
featreq.sent: Request sent to {name}. It awaiteth their OK.
chg.raise.title: Ask for a change: what, why, risk, when and how to undo it
chg.heading: 🔀 Change request
chg.title: Title
prob.heading: 🧩 Problem
risks.title: ⚠️ Risks
risks.btn.title: The risk register: what may go amiss, highest score first
risks.error: The risks could not be loaded.
risks.none: No risks yet. Agents add one when they plan a perilous card.
expert.btn.title: Add an expert (legal, money, design ...) to this project
expert.sub: Pick whom thou needest, or describe it. They join the company and bid good day in the Lead chat.
expert.describe.ph: e.g. someone to check my terms and conditions
expert.looks.none: Naught specific found, so thou gettest a {label}. Thy lead may suggest a fairer fit.
expert.err: Pick an expert or describe whom thou needest.
expert.request.pick: No keyword matched, so this is a generalist. Lead: if another expert fit better, say so.
expert.intro: Well met, I am {name}, thy {label} expert. I can aid with {can}. Tell me what thou needest and I shall begin.
expert.can.dev: building features, mending bugs and writing scripts
expert.can.ops: servers, hosting, domains, deploys and backups
expert.can.a11y: making things usable with a screen reader, keyboard and good contrast
expert.can.strategy: business plans, markets, rivals and growth
expert.can.lawyer: contracts, terms, licences, trademarks and copyright
expert.can.pricing: pricing, budgets, cash flow and funding
expert.can.hr: hiring, job ads, interviews and company culture
expert.can.social: social media, SEO and advertising campaigns
expert.can.helpdesk: customer questions, FAQs, complaints and refunds
expert.can.tester: test plans, testing and regression checks
expert.can.generalist: general questions, planning and finding the right specialist
swarm.this.title: All hands on deck: every company works upon this project, companies elsewhere halt at a safe point
swarm.off.title: End the swarm: held companies in other projects wake again
swarm.confirm: Swarm {name}? Every company dropeth what it doth and worketh upon it; companies running in other projects are bid halt at a safe point.
allhands.name: 📣 All hands
allhands.title: 📣 All hands: {text}
allhands.help: Send one message to every active project's company.
phone.help: Read and answer thy DMs upon thy phone, o'er thine own Tailscale network. On this computer run the command below once, then pair thy phone here.
phone.name: Name
phone.link.help: Scan this with thy phone camera, or open the link upon thy phone. It serveth once, for 10 minutes.
phone.qr: QR code with the pairing link
phone.onpc: Pair or remove phones in Setup upon thy computer.
phone.pair.bad: This pairing link is spent or out of date. In Setup upon thy computer, click Pair a phone anew and scan the new code.
phone.unpaired: This phone is not paired with the board. In Setup upon thy computer, click Pair a phone and scan the code.
phone.app.help: Scan this with the AI-gile app upon thy phone. It holdeth the app's own key and is shown but now: close this page and it is gone. Remove the Android app below to stay it.
mail.nav.title: Thy mail inbox
mail.title: ✉️ Mail
mail.none: No mailbox yet. Add one in Setup > ✉️ Mail.
mail.col.subject: Subject
mail.streamer: Mail is hid in streamer mode.
mail.setup.help: Read a mailbox here (IMAP over SSL/TLS, usually port 993). Use an app password if thy provider hath them. The password is kept encrypted upon this computer and never shown again.
mail.setup.name: Name
mail.setup.notfound: No server answered on port 993. Ask thy mail host for the IMAP server name.
mail.setup.pass.keep: Leave blank to keep the saved one
mail.setup.remove.sure: Remove this mailbox, its password and its cache?
swarm.worker.title: Swarm worker on branch {branch}: {title}. Click for its log.
swarm.workers.help: While swarm is on, the board runneth one worker per To do card, each in its own git worktree, up to this many at once.
dms.close.title: Close this chat (it returneth when a new message cometh)
hf.btn.title: Show only this project and thy DMs (naught else changeth for the companies)
hf.chip.title: Open the project upon which thou art hyperfocused
sc.msg.shower: 'Tis time for a shower or bath
sc.msg.eyes: Look from the screen a while
sc.msg.bedtime: 'Tis time to wind down for bed
sc.meds.help: Meds are at set hours, not every so many minutes. The nudge returneth every 10 minutes till thou press Done, and heedeth not quiet hours.
sc.quiet.help: Meds still nudge during quiet hours.
break.btn.title: Take a break: alerts, sound and pop-ups pause, the company keepeth working
break.sub: Alerts and pop-ups pause till the time is up. Thy company keepeth working.
break.away.none: Whilst thou wert away: all quiet.
break.shower.btn.title: Start shower mode now: alerts pause for 30 minutes
life.letsgo.title: Starteth shower mode on a shower reminder, else putteth it off an hour (not done)
break.shower.sub: Alerts are paused. Thy company keepeth working.
look.server.sub: Which of thy servers this project's server tasks open (Setup > My servers). User and folder here replace the server's own.
lead.dayStart: ☀️ Offer Start my day each morning
lead.dayStart.help: The first time thou openest the board each day, one check-in showeth thy tasks, tests, life admin and mail count, with buttons to leap to each. Thou mayst also open it from the home page at any hour.
md.btn.title: One check-in: tasks, tests, life admin and mail
md.intro: A quick look at today. Tap a button to leap thither.
md.pick.intro: Tick the projects thou workest on today. The others rest.
la.link.title: Reminders and lists, no AI
la.title: Life admin
la.intro: Reminders and simple lists, kept as plain data upon this computer. Naught here waketh an agent or costeth tokens.
la.tick.title: Done (a repeating reminder moveth to its next time)
la.untick.title: Put it back
la.snooze.title: Come back in an hour
la.tomorrow.title: Come back tomorrow at 09:00
la.list.name: New list (shopping, to pack...)
la.err.text: Type what thou wouldst be reminded of.
la.note: No AI needed: this page never calleth one.
gloss.intro.noai: The words developers use, in plain English.
gonogo.heading: Go / no go
gonogo.declined: No go: back to To do
gonogo.note.ph: A note (needed for No go: what must change)
gonogo.comment.anyway: Go anyway (decision, the owner o'erruled the chain): {note}
call.title: Openeth the call in a new tab (the call tool doth the video and screen sharing)
call.ph: https://meet.google.com/... or a Jitsi, Discord or Teams link
call.intro: One link for stand-ups and calls. AI-gile showeth but a Join call link; the call tool doth the video and screen sharing.
tb.pin.help: Tick what stayeth in the bar; the rest is under More. Setup ever stayeth.
phone.step2.wait: The QR code appeareth here after step 1.
phone.step3.help: Thy phone openeth AI-gile and appeareth in the list below. Thou mayst remove it there at any time.
home.more.title: Show or hide the other buttons
home.uz.html: ⚡ Plan left: this session {h5} · this week {wk}
wz.ask.b.wizard.help: About a minute. Setteth things up for thee (recommended).
wz.ask.b.tour.help: A short guided look round the board.
wz.ask.b.in.help: Skip all this. Thou mayst run the wizard or tour later.
card.menu.title: More actions
day.start: When doth thy day usually start?
day.help: Going quiet endeth at thy start time unless thou pick another, and Snooze to tomorrow waketh things then.
storage.tidy: Attachments on closed (done) cards older than {days} days: {n} files, {size}
storage.confirm: Delete {n} attachment files ({size}) from closed cards? Naught else is removed.
storage.nothing: No attachments on closed cards older than {days} days to tidy up.
share.title.label: Title
share.preview.label: Preview link
share.title.help: The title is a label only: it showeth next to {name} upon thy side and on their board header.
share.preview.help: A preview link (http or https) giveth {name} a Preview button; leave it empty for none.
share.simple.help: Alpha tester, comments on, Approvals on
share.simple.hint: Setteth Alpha tester, comments on and Approvals on for this project. Their wishes land in ✅ Approvals.
pub.feedback.sub: Visitors to thine own website may report a problem; each report becometh a bug card in To do.
pub.feedback.group: Put the cards in this group (optional)
